name: cubby-firestore-rules-test
description: Cross-account emulator test for firestore.rules. Run green before publishing tightened rules.

scripts.test:rules: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-cubby "node test/rules-test.js"
scripts.test:invitelink: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-cubby "node test/invite-link.test.js"
scripts.test:pushquery: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-cubby "node test/push-query.test.js"
